guest_staging.initial_transfer_difference: The guest umask tightened the generated Hub pack directory from 0755 to 0700 and its single pack from 0640 to 0600; both file bytes and SHA-256 matched the reviewed host source.
guest_staging.correction: Before any process start, the two guest modes were set to their exact reviewed host modes.
guest_staging.post_correction_comparison: PASS for all 44 directories, regular files and symbolic links by type, mode, size and file SHA-256

failed_launch.receiver_exit: The receiver exited before opening its data or status listener because TESLATLAS_FLEET_TELEMETRY_BEARER_FILE was not supplied to that first invocation.
failed_launch.reason_no_retry: Static inspection of the exact accepted receiver binary then proved its immutable dispatcher URL is http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/internal/fleet-telemetry, while the accepted r10 Edge configuration listens on 127.0.0.1:8086. Supplying the bearer environment would not repair that source/profile mismatch.

root_cause.accepted_source_contract_evidence: teslatlas-edge/docs/development/edge-macos-forwarding-contract-proposal-2026-09-12-r1.json fixes the same receiver binary to port 8080 and requires TESLATLAS_FLEET_TELEMETRY_BEARER_FILE.

cleanup.removed_from_host_and_guest: All r10 private keys, certificates, spool key, receiver and Hub bearers, Hub credential store, and Hub cursor key.
cleanup.retained: Owner-only non-secret preparation evidence, inactive binding, stopped Hub fixture, redacted configuration and receiver failure log.

decision: r10 is closed and non-reusable. A successor must use a fresh root, identity tuple, credentials, PKI and ports, bind Edge internal admission to 127.0.0.1:8080, and launch the receiver with the exact bearer-file environment.
proof_boundary: r10 proves source/profile preparation, stopped-fixture identity binding, exact guest staging and fail-closed pre-listener diagnosis. It is not a zero-event baseline, forwarding, producer, event, installed-service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance result.
